display_name: Francisco de Almeida & Amir Hussain Al-Kurdi
one_line: Rival admirals at the 1509 Battle of Diu, when Portuguese cannon and Red Sea–Indian Ocean alliances reshaped Indian Ocean trade.

appearance.age_look: Francisco appears late 40s with a seasoned, broad-shouldered build; Amir Hussain appears late 30s, lean and athletic.
appearance.face: Francisco has a square face, tanned Iberian complexion, short greying beard and moustache, strong nose, and sharp, serious eyes with a stern default expression; Amir Hussain has an oval face, light brown Eastern Mediterranean complexion, neatly trimmed black beard, arched brows and calm, focused eyes with a composed, strategic default expression.
appearance.hair: Francisco’s dark brown hair, streaked with grey, is cut short and swept back under a dark crimson 16th‑century Portuguese beret-style cap with a narrow brim; Amir Hussain’s black hair is mostly hidden under a white wrapped turban with a slim dark green band and a small, simple metal cap at the crown.
appearance.costume: Francisco wears early 16th‑century Portuguese naval attire: over a cream linen shirt with a modest standing collar he has a dark forest green doublet of thick wool, quilted and slightly padded with vertical stitching, laced at the front, its shoulders covered by a sleeveless dark brown leather jerkin; his sleeves are slashed at the upper arms to show hints of cream fabric, and he wears a narrow dark red sash tied at his left hip; below, he has sturdy dark brown wool hose tucked into mid‑calf height brown leather sea boots with folded cuffs; a simple bronze cross pendant hangs at his chest, and a wide dark brown leather belt with a brass buckle supports a sword scabbard and a small pouch; Amir Hussain wears a long, modest Ottoman‑Mamluk style naval coat (qabā) in deep indigo blue, of medium‑weight cloth with subtle vertical woven stripes, reaching mid‑calf and belted at the waist with a broad dark brown leather belt; beneath, a pale off‑white cotton tunic with a round neck and long sleeves shows at the collar and cuffs; his loose sand‑coloured trousers are tucked into ankle‑height brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; over his shoulders he has a sleeveless, slightly flared dark green cloth vest reinforced with small, overlapping rectangular leather plates sewn inside for protection, visible as faint vertical rows; his belt also carries a small dagger in a simple sheath and a fabric pouch, and he wears a plain silver ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: Francisco grips a long, slightly curved early 16th‑century Portuguese naval officer’s sword with a simple brass crossguard and brown leather-wrapped hilt, its plain steel blade in a dark brown scabbard; Amir Hussain carries a slender, slightly curved Red Sea–style naval sabre with a plain steel blade, simple crossguard, and dark wood hilt, sheathed in a muted dark brown leather scabbard worn at his left hip.

ref_desc: Francisco de Almeida is a broad-shouldered, tanned, square-faced Iberian with short greying hair under a dark crimson beret, green quilted doublet, brown leather jerkin, cream shirt, brown hose and boots, brass-hilted sword, while Amir Hussain Al-Kurdi is a lean, light-brown, oval-faced bearded admiral in a white turban with green band, indigo naval coat, dark green reinforced vest, sand trousers, brown shoes and a slender sabre at his hip, their shared palette of dark green, indigo, brown, cream and dark red unifying the design.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet showing two rival admirals standing side by side in front of an abstract harbour backdrop: Francisco de Almeida and Amir Hussain Al-Kurdi rendered consistently from head to toe. Francisco is broad-shouldered and tanned, with a square face, short dark brown hair streaked with grey, a short greying beard and moustache, and stern eyes; he wears a dark crimson beret-style cap, a dark forest green padded doublet over a cream linen shirt, a sleeveless dark brown leather jerkin over the doublet, slashed sleeves showing cream fabric, a narrow dark red sash at his left hip, dark brown wool hose, and mid-calf brown leather sea boots with folded cuffs, plus a wide dark brown belt with brass buckle and small pouch. His signature weapon is a long, slightly curved Portuguese naval officer’s sword with a simple brass crossguard and brown leather-wrapped hilt, sheathed in a dark brown scabbard at his left side, which he holds or rests his hand upon. Amir Hussain is lean with an oval face, light brown Eastern Mediterranean complexion, neatly trimmed black beard, calm focused eyes, and black hair hidden under a white wrapped turban with a slim dark green band and a small metal cap at the crown; he wears a deep indigo long naval coat with subtle vertical stripes reaching mid-calf, belted with a broad dark brown leather belt, over a pale off-white tunic showing at the collar and cuffs, with a dark green sleeveless vest subtly reinforced with internal leather plates, sand-coloured loose trousers, and brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes, plus a simple silver ring and a small dagger at his belt. Use a harmonious palette dominated by dark forest green, indigo blue, dark brown, cream, and dark red, and present multiple angles and neutral poses so both characters’ face shapes, hair, outfits, and signature swords can be redrawn identically in future panels.
